sn35.31:1.1: “Conducive to” (_sappāya_) is a synonym of “fit for” (_sāruppa_) in the previous discourse.
sn35.31:1.8: _Bhava_ means “existence” or “being”, not “becoming”. Those who are “attached to being” are not attached to “becoming” something else; that would be _vibhavataṇhā_, “craving for nonexistence”. They are are attached to a state of eternal existence, to continuing to exist in another life (_bhavataṇhā_). They conceive this to be an eternal self, but their conceiving is ultimately derived from sense experience, which is always changing.
